blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Education (DepEd) is expanding its learner-led peer facilitation network through the My Buddy System alongside structured counseling and teacher check-ins to build safer, more supportive school environments, as part of its mental health and psychosocial support framework. Launched during the observance of National School Safety Week, the My Buddy System initiative is a key component of DepEd’s broader School Safety Campaign. By tapping into learner networks, DepEd aims to encourage early help-seeking while keeping adult professionals strictly in charge of risk assessments, formal referrals, and specialized care.
